concerns.text: Task T012c is marked as [X] (completed) but the spec.md and plan.md still contain 'PubGraph' references (FR-001, Assumptions). The task description says 'Update... to replace ALL occurrences', yet the artifacts remain unchanged. This creates a missing implementation for the spec requirement to use OpenAlex, blocking downstream data ingestion tasks (T040, T012) which rely on the corrected spec.

Task T022 implements novelty as 'cosine distance to its OWN topic_cluster centroid'. While this matches the literal text of FR-004, the spec's User Story 2 Acceptance Scenario 3 ('nodes with identical titles have zero novelty distance') and the 'Why this priority' section (measuring deviation from topic mean) imply a need for outlier detection. However, the critical coverage gap is that T022's verification relies on T019 (test_novelty_centroid_distance) which is marked [X] but the input artifact `data/processed/final_analysis_dataset.parquet` (T024) is missing. The task chain is broken: T022 cannot be verified without T024, and T024 depends on T022. This circular dependency leaves the FR-004 requirement untestable.

Task T037 (Integration test for full statistical pipeline) is marked [X] (completed) but depends on `data/processed/final_analysis_dataset.parquet` (T024), which is flagged as missing/invalid. Without the actual dataset, T037 cannot validate the 'associational' label or p-value correction on real data, leaving FR-007 and FR-006 unverified in the implementation.

Tasks T016 and T024 are marked [X] (completed) but their output artifacts (`subgraph_with_clusters.parquet`, `final_analysis_dataset.parquet`) are missing. This breaks the traceability for all downstream tasks (T025-T061) that require these files, leaving FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, and FR-008 unimplemented in the actual codebase.

Task T059 (Statistical Power Analysis) has no corresponding requirement in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-008) or plan.md. It is an untraceable task (stale tag/scope creep) that adds implementation burden without a spec mandate.

Task T060 (Graph Serialization to .graphml) has no corresponding requirement in spec.md or plan.md, which exclusively specify Parquet format. This is an untraceable task adding unnecessary complexity.
Task T061 (Text Preprocessing Audit) has no corresponding requirement in spec.md or plan.md. While beneficial for reproducibility, it is not a mandated deliverable and represents an untraceable task.
